title: WORK-LAB Future Candidate Registry
description: Single machine registry of deferred/deferred-pilot candidate directions (external workspaces, context/memory engines, web-agent routes, evaluator/experiment lanes). Every entry is DEFERRED with default_enabled=false unless promotion evidence exists. This registry is a planning/persistence layer, NOT an execution authority: it grants no install, download, clone, or pilot permission. Pilot execution requires an individually authorized task card in taskpacks/current.

intake.description: Fixed external-capability intake pipeline (GOAL 18): DISCOVER -> CLASSIFY -> NATIVE OVERLAP -> LICENSE -> VERSION -> PERMISSION -> DATA BOUNDARY -> WINDOWS SUPPORT -> INSTALL SIDE EFFECT -> PILOT -> EVIDENCE -> DECISION

license.description: Verify before any pilot. NOT_VERIFIED is an honest state, not a failure.

task_card.description: Path of the individually authorized task card if one exists; null when not yet authorized.

discovery.description: Outcome of the DISCOVER stage. RESOLVED means one locatable upstream; AMBIGUOUS means the name matches several or none in role; NOT_FOUND means the search came back empty. It is never a synonym for unverified.

upstream.description: org/repo of the resolved upstream; empty unless discovery is RESOLVED.

license_spdx.description: The SPDX the readback returned, including UNKNOWN or NOASSERTION when the repository declares none. Never inferred.

windows_evidence.description: What the Windows signal actually was (README badge, release asset, nothing) and how strong it is. Required when windows_support is VERIFIED.

decision.description: One of governance.decisions. REJECT is a dated retirement that keeps its reversal condition in pilot_trigger, not a deletion.

decision_basis.description: Why the row is still needed, evaluated against the native code paths in native_evidence. Required for PROMOTE and KEEP_CANDIDATE; rejected rows carry the reasoning in rejection_reason.

absorption.description: How much of this candidate's role this repository already implements. Anything other than NONE must name existing paths in native_evidence.

native_evidence.description: Repository-relative paths that must exist; the coverage a decision is claimed against.

blocker.description: What stops a kept candidate from being piloted now; required for KEEP_CANDIDATE. Empty means nothing blocks it, which then demands a pilot rather than another year of deferral.
